subject: Re: MEETING OF THE COUNCIL - 22 OCTOBER AT 7.00PM
source: Original email in the family's Gmail (read-only export); contact details redacted.
text:
Dear [family member],

Please see below my response to your questions as promised.

1. What consideration was my first approach given before the reply of 20 
November 2025? - You need to be more specific about what you are looking 
for in relation to this question.
2. Does the Council hold any Tŷ Mawr records besides the minute books 
deposited in 2002 (my email of 14 June)? Uncertain at this stage pending 
the outcome of the internal review which you have requested.
3. Which agenda items cover the "other matters" your email of 11 October 
said would be considered in October? These related to the two specific 
questions you posed which were included on the agenda.
4. Who decided the meeting would be remote only, and on what date? The 
Council decided to hold the meeting remotely for the reason given to you 
by the Chair at the meeting on 22 October 2026
5. When was the website agenda revised and republished? It was amended 
in good time to provide for the three clear day's notice of the meeting.
6. Where are the published arrangements for multi-location meetings 
(s.47, LGE(W)A 2021)? The arrangements for how community council 
meetings may be held are detailed in the statutory guidance for 
community councils - 
https://www.gov.wales/sites/default/files/publications/2022-08/statutory-guidance-for-community-and-town-councils.pdf
